decision.observation: The white melee-weapon icon with an arrow floats mid-screen in the smoke, and a second small icon sits at the far-right edge on a dark square. The arrow may be a waypoint hint rather than a bearing indicator.

decision.memory: Prompt icon and arrow appear static across many camera moves — treat it as a waypoint to the right edge, not a bearing.
